rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=214, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=150, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_render=raster, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_amp_init_max=0.05, gs_ssim_weight=0.4, gs_outer_wall_s=1080, rationale=iter-9 (search-20260619-01) — AUTHORIZED audit-fix (b) SSIM-weight continuation, push-or-saturate. ONE KNOB: gs_ssim_weight 0.25->0.4 (BASE_ITER=8 BEST: gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, gs_n_iter=150, 512 Gaussians, gs_amp_init_max=0.05 — the config that set run-best SSIM 0.7696). LIMITER: r2gaussian is REGIME-BOUNDED on dense 2304-view Mayo — LD-FBP (~0.808) is near-complete, the inverse is not ill-posed enough for a Gaussian-splat prior to add value, so hr>0 is implausible regardless. The live SSIM lever is the audit-fix (b) SSIM-weight pull toward FBP structure, now with DIMINISHING returns: iter-6 SSIM@0.10 0.7519 -> iter-7 @0.15 0.7641 (+0.0122) -> iter-8 @0.25 0.7696 (+0.0055). HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): a stronger SSIM pull (0.25->0.4) nudges the ~26 completed scenes further AT/ABOVE their FBP init, so the 214-avg SSIM rises modestly above iter-8 0.7696 toward the 0.808 LD-FBP floor. PREDICTION: SSIM in (0.770, 0.79), hr 0 (regime-bounded — even matching FBP yields hr=0). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.7696 (no lift over iter-8 best), the SSIM-weight lever is SATURATED on dense Mayo — fix VALIDATED AS FAITHFUL-BUT-REGIME-BOUNDED (its real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks). BUDGET: gs_init_from_fbp adds ~0 per-step cost (init only); the SSIM term is one cheap conv-SSIM per step vs the dominating 2304-view projection, so per-step stays ~0.282 s and coverage ~26/214 (same as iter-8, elapsed_s 1125.3 < 1800 SLURM wall). gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncates before the 30-min kill, val figure excluded. val_n=214 per mandate; staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom / per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe) / bg_target=truth / 321px-FOV-default / gs_render=raster all hard-wired. gs_render stays raster (the splat path is the DEFERRED (a) fix and raises NotImplementedError); gs_n_iter held at 150 (the under-budget gs_n_iter-up lever is DEFERRED post-TPE). TRAJECTORY: iter-7 0.7641 (SSIM@0.15) -> iter-8 0.7696 (SSIM@0.25, BEST) -> iter-9 = SSIM weight 0.25->0.4, the push-or-saturate test of the authorized audit-fix (b).
